headline: EXCITEBIKE now teaches its own length
lede: The your-laps polish pass landed: the bay flinches when you hit the ends of the lap book, a first save explains what the LAP tool does, phone rows fit again, and the over screen says how far you actually rode.

notes.text: Off-book customs end on `CUSTOM 1 · 5 LAPS` — the NES edit runs announced their distance, and now the over screen does too.
The LAP wheel tells at its ends: arriving at 8 and wrapping back to 1 flinch the tool cell white with a double-note; mid-book presses keep the plain step tone.
A first default-book save teaches `TIP: LAP SETS YOUR RACE LENGTH` (once, ever), and the splash badge takes a compact `★ 3L` form so 375px rows clear the pack pips.
excitecheck 469/469 (+18 pins; a hand mutant on the wrap condition dies on two named lines) and exciteplay 160/160 (+9 real-key gates incl. the 375px clearance law).

look.text: Set LAP to 5, save, ride — the over screen names your book
